CVE-2023-25825.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2023-25825.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television software application for Linux which supports IP, USB and Analog cameras. Versions prior to 1.36.33 are vulnerable to Cross-site Scripting. Log entries can be injected into the database logs, containing a malicious referrer field. CVE-2023-26032.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2023-26032.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television software application for Linux which supports IP, USB and Analog cameras. Versions prior to 1.36.33 and 1.37.33 contain SQL Injection via malicious jason web token. The Username field of the JWT token was trusted when performing an SQL query to load the user.  If an attacker could determine the HASH key used by ZoneMinder, they could generate a malicious JWT token and use it to execute arbitrary SQL. This issue is fixed in versions 1.36.33 and 1.37.33.

CVE-2023-26034.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2023-26034.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television software application for Linux which supports IP, USB and Analog cameras. Versions prior to 1.36.33 and 1.37.33 are affected by a SQL Injection vulnerability. The (blind) SQL Injection vulnerability is present within the `filter[Query][terms][0][attr]` query string parameter of the  `/zm/index.php` endpoint. A user with the View or Edit permissions of Events may execute arbitrary SQL. The resulting impact can include unauthorized data access (and modification), authentication and/or authorization bypass, and remote code execution.

CVE-2023-26036.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2023-26036.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television software application for Linux which supports IP, USB and Analog cameras. Versions prior to 1.36.33 and 1.37.33 contain a Local File Inclusion (Untrusted Search Path) vulnerability via /web/index.php. By controlling $view, any local file ending in .php can be executed. This is supposed to be mitigated by calling detaintPath, however dentaintPath does not properly sandbox the path. This can be exploited by constructing paths like "..././", which get replaced by "../". This issue is patched in versions 1.36.33 and 1.37.33.

Versions prior to 1.36.33 and 1.37.33 contain an SQL Injection. The minTime and maxTime request parameters are not properly validated and could be used execute arbitrary SQL. This issue is fixed in versions 1.36.33 and 1.37.33.

CVE-2024-43359.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2024-43359.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. ZoneMinder has a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the montagereview via the displayinterval, speed, and scale parameters. This vulnerability is fixed in 1.36.34 and 1.37.61.

CVE-2024-43360.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2024-43360.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. ZoneMinder is affected by a time-based SQL Injection vulnerability. This vulnerability is fixed in 1.36.34 and 1.37.61.

CVE-2024-43361.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2024-43361.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. CVE-2025-65791.title: ZoneMinder v1.36.34 is vulnerable to Command Injection in web/vie ...
CVE-2025-65791.description: ZoneMinder v1.36.34 is vulnerable to Command Injection in web/views/image.php. The application passes unsanitized user input directly to the exec() function. NOTE: this is disputed by the Supplier because there is no unsanitized user input to web/views/image.php.

CVE-2026-102296.title: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 contains static buffer overflow vulnerab ...
CVE-2026-102296.description: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 contains static buffer overflow vulnerabilities in RemoteCameraHttp::GetResponse() that allow malicious HTTP cameras or intercepting attackers to overflow fixed-size buffers by sending oversized response headers. Attackers can send crafted HTTP responses with oversized status messages, Connection headers, Content-Type values, or multipart boundaries to corrupt parser state and crash the capture process or corrupt memory.

CVE-2026-102297.title: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 fails to apply per-monitor access restri ...
CVE-2026-102297.description: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 fails to apply per-monitor access restrictions in the FramesController index endpoint. Authenticated users with Events view permission can call the frames API to list frame records from monitors they are denied access to, disclosing event and frame metadata across monitor boundaries.

CVE-2026-102607.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-102607.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.3, the exportEvents() function concatenates the attacker-controlled exportFile request parameter into a shell command without neutralizing shell metacharacters when an authenticated user with View Events or View Snapshots permission submits an event export request with a crafted exportFile value, a valid CSRF token, and exportDetail enabled. The affected components are exportEvents(), exportFile, web/ajax/event.php, web/skins/classic/includes/export_functions.php. In this attack mechanism, the crafted exportFile value reaches the trailing directory argument of a tar or zip command executed by exec(). The attacker can execute arbitrary operating system commands as the web server user. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.3.

CVE-2026-102608.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-102608.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.3, downloadEvents() manually wraps a monitor Name value in single quotes instead of using escapeshellarg() before placing it in shell commands when a user with monitor-create or monitor-edit permission stores a monitor Name containing shell metacharacters and a user with Events View permission exports that monitor's events. In this attack mechanism, the stored monitor Name reaches both the ffmpeg concatenation command and the tar or zip archive command and breaks out of manual quoting. Arbitrary commands execute as the web server user. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.3.

CVE-2026-104198.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-104198.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. In versions 1.34.0 through 1.36.38, the web interface mishandles failed token authentication in web/includes/auth.php. validateToken() returns false when a token is malformed or has an invalid signature, but the caller assigns that value to the global $user variable; because web/index.php tests isset($user), boolean false is treated as a present user and the normal login redirect is skipped. This can dispatch views that rely on the outer authentication gate, including the zones view, which accepts an attacker-selected monitor ID and discloses monitor and zone metadata without an independent permission check. Permission helpers receive the false user value and deny privileged operations, so unauthorized state changes have not been established. This vulnerability is fixed in version 1.36.63, where conversion to ZM\User objects causes invalid token state to fail before view dispatch. Later defense-in-depth changes explicitly leave $user unset after failed token validation and reject non-ZM\User values at the web authentication gate.

CVE-2026-27470.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-27470.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. In versions 1.36.37 and below and 1.37.61 through 1.38.0, there is a second-order SQL Injection vulnerability in the web/ajax/status.php file within the getNearEvents() function. Event field values (specifically Name and Cause) are stored safely via parameterized queries but are later retrieved and concatenated directly into SQL WHERE clauses without escaping. An authenticated user with Events edit and view permissions can exploit this to execute arbitrary SQL queries.

CVE-2026-28273.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-28273.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.4, any authenticated user can use the /api/configs/edit/{name}.json endpoint to modify protected configuration settings because ConfigsController::edit() does not enforce the System=Edit authorization requirement and its system-variable protection is ineffective. An attacker can set ZM_PATH_FFMPEG to a command-bearing value and trigger an exec() sink in web/views/image.php or web/includes/Event.php by requesting frame extraction. This permits arbitrary command execution with the privileges of the web server user and can expose private camera feeds, recordings, and database data or establish persistence. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.4.

CVE-2026-30971.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-30971.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.39.2, 1.38.2, and 1.36.40, ZoneMinder interpolates an unvalidated monitor Device field into shell commands in PHP and Perl control paths when an authenticated user with monitor-create or monitor-edit permission saves a Local monitor whose Device Path contains shell metacharacters and the monitor control or startup path runs. In this attack mechanism, the stored Device value reaches Perl qx() and backtick execution before zmdc.pl argument detainting, while separate PHP command paths use bypassable escapeshellcmd defenses. The attacker can execute arbitrary commands as the web server user. This vulnerability is fixed in 1.39.2, 1.38.2, and 1.36.40.

CVE-2026-54258.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-54258.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Versions prior to 1.36.39, 1.38.4, and 1.39.11 allow an authenticated low-privileged user with coarse `Events=View` and/or `Snapshots=View` permissions to directly fetch media for events belonging to monitors they are not allowed to access. The normal UI correctly hides the restricted monitor and its events, but direct event media views accept an arbitrary `eid` and stream media from the event path without enforcing the event/monitor-level ACL. This exposes private surveillance footage across monitor boundaries. Versions 1.36.39, 1.38.4, and 1.39.11 fix the issue.

CVE-2026-72556.title: A remote code execution vulnerability in ZoneMinder 1.39.17 allow ...
CVE-2026-72556.description: A remote code execution vulnerability in ZoneMinder 1.39.17 allows any authenticated user to execute OS commands by exploiting a broken permission check in the Filter class. The canEdit() and canDelete() methods invoke nonexistent methods on the ZM\User class, causing PHP __call() to return a truthy value that bypasses the permission check for all users. Any authenticated user can trigger filter-based OS command execution regardless of their assigned role.

CVE-2026-76060.description: An authenticated OS command injection vulnerability exists in ZoneMinder's event export functionality. The exportFile HTTP request parameter is passed unsanitized into a shell command executed via PHP's exec(), allowing any authenticated user with View Events permission to execute arbitrary operating system commands on the server.

CVE-2025-65791.title: ZoneMinder v1.36.34 is vulnerable to Command Injection in web/vie ...

CVE-2026-102296.title: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 contains static buffer overflow vulnerab ...
CVE-2026-102296.description: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 contains static buffer overflow vulnerabilities in RemoteCameraHttp::GetResponse() that allow malicious HTTP cameras or intercepting attackers to overflow fixed-size buffers by sending oversized response headers. CVE-2026-102297.title: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 fails to apply per-monitor access restri ...
CVE-2026-102297.description: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 fails to apply per-monitor access restrictions in the FramesController index endpoint. Authenticated users with Events view permission can call the frames API to list frame records from monitors they are denied access to, disclosing event and frame metadata across monitor boundaries.

CVE-2026-102607.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-102607.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.3, the exportEvents() function concatenates the attacker-controlled exportFile request parameter into a shell command without neutralizing shell metacharacters when an authenticated user with View Events or View Snapshots permission submits an event export request with a crafted exportFile value, a valid CSRF token, and exportDetail enabled. The affected components are exportEvents(), exportFile, web/ajax/event.php, web/skins/classic/includes/export_functions.php. In this attack mechanism, the crafted exportFile value reaches the trailing directory argument of a tar or zip command executed by exec(). The attacker can execute arbitrary operating system commands as the web server user. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.3.

CVE-2026-102608.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-102608.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.3, downloadEvents() manually wraps a monitor Name value in single quotes instead of using escapeshellarg() before placing it in shell commands when a user with monitor-create or monitor-edit permission stores a monitor Name containing shell metacharacters and a user with Events View permission exports that monitor's events. In this attack mechanism, the stored monitor Name reaches both the ffmpeg concatenation command and the tar or zip archive command and breaks out of manual quoting. Arbitrary commands execute as the web server user. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.3.

CVE-2026-104198.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-104198.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. In versions 1.34.0 through 1.36.38, the web interface mishandles failed token authentication in web/includes/auth.php. validateToken() returns false when a token is malformed or has an invalid signature, but the caller assigns that value to the global $user variable; because web/index.php tests isset($user), boolean false is treated as a present user and the normal login redirect is skipped. This can dispatch views that rely on the outer authentication gate, including the zones view, which accepts an attacker-selected monitor ID and discloses monitor and zone metadata without an independent permission check. Permission helpers receive the false user value and deny privileged operations, so unauthorized state changes have not been established. This vulnerability is fixed in version 1.36.63, where conversion to ZM\User objects causes invalid token state to fail before view dispatch. Later defense-in-depth changes explicitly leave $user unset after failed token validation and reject non-ZM\User values at the web authentication gate.

CVE-2026-27470.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-27470.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. In versions 1.36.37 and below and 1.37.61 through 1.38.0, there is a second-order SQL Injection vulnerability in the web/ajax/status.php file within the getNearEvents() function. Event field values (specifically Name and Cause) are stored safely via parameterized queries but are later retrieved and concatenated directly into SQL WHERE clauses without escaping. An authenticated user with Events edit and view permissions can exploit this to execute arbitrary SQL queries.

CVE-2026-28273.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-28273.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.4, any authenticated user can use the /api/configs/edit/{name}.json endpoint to modify protected configuration settings because ConfigsController::edit() does not enforce the System=Edit authorization requirement and its system-variable protection is ineffective. An attacker can set ZM_PATH_FFMPEG to a command-bearing value and trigger an exec() sink in web/views/image.php or web/includes/Event.php by requesting frame extraction. This permits arbitrary command execution with the privileges of the web server user and can expose private camera feeds, recordings, and database data or establish persistence. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.4.

CVE-2026-30971.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-30971.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.39.2, 1.38.2, and 1.36.40, ZoneMinder interpolates an unvalidated monitor Device field into shell commands in PHP and Perl control paths when an authenticated user with monitor-create or monitor-edit permission saves a Local monitor whose Device Path contains shell metacharacters and the monitor control or startup path runs. In this attack mechanism, the stored Device value reaches Perl qx() and backtick execution before zmdc.pl argument detainting, while separate PHP command paths use bypassable escapeshellcmd defenses. The attacker can execute arbitrary commands as the web server user. This vulnerability is fixed in 1.39.2, 1.38.2, and 1.36.40.

CVE-2026-54258.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-54258.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Versions prior to 1.36.39, 1.38.4, and 1.39.11 allow an authenticated low-privileged user with coarse `Events=View` and/or `Snapshots=View` permissions to directly fetch media for events belonging to monitors they are not allowed to access. The normal UI correctly hides the restricted monitor and its events, but direct event media views accept an arbitrary `eid` and stream media from the event path without enforcing the event/monitor-level ACL. This exposes private surveillance footage across monitor boundaries. Versions 1.36.39, 1.38.4, and 1.39.11 fix the issue.

CVE-2026-72556.title: A remote code execution vulnerability in ZoneMinder 1.39.17 allow ...
CVE-2026-72556.description: A remote code execution vulnerability in ZoneMinder 1.39.17 allows any authenticated user to execute OS commands by exploiting a broken permission check in the Filter class. The canEdit() and canDelete() methods invoke nonexistent methods on the ZM\User class, causing PHP __call() to return a truthy value that bypasses the permission check for all users. Any authenticated user can trigger filter-based OS command execution regardless of their assigned role.

CVE-2026-76060.title: An authenticated OS command injection vulnerability exists in Zon ...
CVE-2026-76060.description: An authenticated OS command injection vulnerability exists in ZoneMinder's event export functionality. The exportFile HTTP request parameter is passed unsanitized into a shell command executed via PHP's exec(), allowing any authenticated user with View Events permission to execute arbitrary operating system commands on the server.

CVE-2023-25825.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2023-25825.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television software application for Linux which supports IP, USB and Analog cameras. CVE-2023-26032.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2023-26032.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television software application for Linux which supports IP, USB and Analog cameras. Versions prior to 1.36.33 and 1.37.33 contain SQL Injection via malicious jason web token. The Username field of the JWT token was trusted when performing an SQL query to load the user.  If an attacker could determine the HASH key used by ZoneMinder, they could generate a malicious JWT token and use it to execute arbitrary SQL. This issue is fixed in versions 1.36.33 and 1.37.33.

CVE-2023-26034.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2023-26034.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television software application for Linux which supports IP, USB and Analog cameras. Versions prior to 1.36.33 and 1.37.33 are affected by a SQL Injection vulnerability. The (blind) SQL Injection vulnerability is present within the `filter[Query][terms][0][attr]` query string parameter of the  `/zm/index.php` endpoint. A user with the View or Edit permissions of Events may execute arbitrary SQL. The resulting impact can include unauthorized data access (and modification), authentication and/or authorization bypass, and remote code execution.

CVE-2023-26036.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2023-26036.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source Closed-circuit television software application for Linux which supports IP, USB and Analog cameras. Prior to 1.38.4, detaintPath() in web/includes/functions.php can be bypassed with a PHP stream-wrapper path when sanitizing modal.php input. A remote unauthenticated attacker can submit such a path through the affected input and potentially read unauthorized local files through local file inclusion. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.4.

CVE-2026-102296.title: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 contains static buffer overflow vulnerab ...
CVE-2026-102296.description: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 contains static buffer overflow vulnerabilities in RemoteCameraHttp::GetResponse() that allow malicious HTTP cameras or intercepting attackers to overflow fixed-size buffers by sending oversized response headers. Attackers can send crafted HTTP responses with oversized status messages, Connection headers, Content-Type values, or multipart boundaries to corrupt parser state and crash the capture process or corrupt memory.

CVE-2026-102297.title: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 fails to apply per-monitor access restri ...
CVE-2026-102297.description: ZoneMinder before 1.38.4 fails to apply per-monitor access restrictions in the FramesController index endpoint. Authenticated users with Events view permission can call the frames API to list frame records from monitors they are denied access to, disclosing event and frame metadata across monitor boundaries.

CVE-2026-102607.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-102607.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.3, the exportEvents() function concatenates the attacker-controlled exportFile request parameter into a shell command without neutralizing shell metacharacters when an authenticated user with View Events or View Snapshots permission submits an event export request with a crafted exportFile value, a valid CSRF token, and exportDetail enabled. The affected components are exportEvents(), exportFile, web/ajax/event.php, web/skins/classic/includes/export_functions.php. In this attack mechanism, the crafted exportFile value reaches the trailing directory argument of a tar or zip command executed by exec(). The attacker can execute arbitrary operating system commands as the web server user. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.3.

CVE-2026-102608.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-102608.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.3, downloadEvents() manually wraps a monitor Name value in single quotes instead of using escapeshellarg() before placing it in shell commands when a user with monitor-create or monitor-edit permission stores a monitor Name containing shell metacharacters and a user with Events View permission exports that monitor's events. In this attack mechanism, the stored monitor Name reaches both the ffmpeg concatenation command and the tar or zip archive command and breaks out of manual quoting. Arbitrary commands execute as the web server user. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.3.

CVE-2026-104198.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-104198.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. In versions 1.34.0 through 1.36.38, the web interface mishandles failed token authentication in web/includes/auth.php. validateToken() returns false when a token is malformed or has an invalid signature, but the caller assigns that value to the global $user variable; because web/index.php tests isset($user), boolean false is treated as a present user and the normal login redirect is skipped. This can dispatch views that rely on the outer authentication gate, including the zones view, which accepts an attacker-selected monitor ID and discloses monitor and zone metadata without an independent permission check. Permission helpers receive the false user value and deny privileged operations, so unauthorized state changes have not been established. This vulnerability is fixed in version 1.36.63, where conversion to ZM\User objects causes invalid token state to fail before view dispatch. Later defense-in-depth changes explicitly leave $user unset after failed token validation and reject non-ZM\User values at the web authentication gate.

CVE-2026-28273.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-28273.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.38.4, any authenticated user can use the /api/configs/edit/{name}.json endpoint to modify protected configuration settings because ConfigsController::edit() does not enforce the System=Edit authorization requirement and its system-variable protection is ineffective. An attacker can set ZM_PATH_FFMPEG to a command-bearing value and trigger an exec() sink in web/views/image.php or web/includes/Event.php by requesting frame extraction. This permits arbitrary command execution with the privileges of the web server user and can expose private camera feeds, recordings, and database data or establish persistence. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.4.

CVE-2026-30971.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-30971.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Prior to 1.39.2, 1.38.2, and 1.36.40, ZoneMinder interpolates an unvalidated monitor Device field into shell commands in PHP and Perl control paths when an authenticated user with monitor-create or monitor-edit permission saves a Local monitor whose Device Path contains shell metacharacters and the monitor control or startup path runs. In this attack mechanism, the stored Device value reaches Perl qx() and backtick execution before zmdc.pl argument detainting, while separate PHP command paths use bypassable escapeshellcmd defenses. The attacker can execute arbitrary commands as the web server user. This vulnerability is fixed in 1.39.2, 1.38.2, and 1.36.40.

CVE-2026-54258.title: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television softw ...
CVE-2026-54258.description: ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. Versions prior to 1.36.39, 1.38.4, and 1.39.11 allow an authenticated low-privileged user with coarse `Events=View` and/or `Snapshots=View` permissions to directly fetch media for events belonging to monitors they are not allowed to access. The normal UI correctly hides the restricted monitor and its events, but direct event media views accept an arbitrary `eid` and stream media from the event path without enforcing the event/monitor-level ACL. This exposes private surveillance footage across monitor boundaries. Versions 1.36.39, 1.38.4, and 1.39.11 fix the issue.

CVE-2026-72556.title: A remote code execution vulnerability in ZoneMinder 1.39.17 allow ...
CVE-2026-72556.description: A remote code execution vulnerability in ZoneMinder 1.39.17 allows any authenticated user to execute OS commands by exploiting a broken permission check in the Filter class. The canEdit() and canDelete() methods invoke nonexistent methods on the ZM\User class, causing PHP __call() to return a truthy value that bypasses the permission check for all users. Any authenticated user can trigger filter-based OS command execution regardless of their assigned role.

CVE-2026-76060.title: An authenticated OS command injection vulnerability exists in Zon ...
CVE-2026-76060.description: An authenticated OS command injection vulnerability exists in ZoneMinder's event export functionality. The exportFile HTTP request parameter is passed unsanitized into a shell command executed via PHP's exec(), allowing any authenticated user with View Events permission to execute arbitrary operating system commands on the server.
